title: d1-omni
what: The app's bundled sample (Load sample): an invented pet-grooming shop's customer sends a voice note (booking a bath and a trim for their dog on Saturday morning), a photo of their dog and a message (charged twice for Saturday, refund one); the default question of each input. The voice note is speech synthesised with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) from a line written for this demo; the photo is the model repository's public check-set file (CC0 1.0).

media.licence: speech synthesised with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0, voice am_michael) from a line written for this demo
media.text: Hi, I'd like to book a grooming appointment for my dog on Saturday morning, a bath and a trim, please.

topic.instructions: What is the customer asking for?

criteria.prices: A question about prices or opening hours

media.licence: CC0 1.0 photograph from Wikimedia Commons (Two_French_bulldogs_swimming_in_life_jackets.jpg), long side resized to 384 px

animal.instructions: What animal is in the photo?

inputs.label: Message
inputs.state: You charged me twice for the bath and trim on Saturday, please refund one of them.
